list.name: point
list.label: Measurement points
list.query: SELECT point_id FROM series WHERE kind = 'measurement' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT point_id FROM series WHERE kind = 'measurement' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Measurements (every reading)
panels.description: Raw readings of the chosen measurement points (BAD left out). Choose points at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.sensor_time AS time, s.point_id AS metric, r.value_num AS value
FROM readings r JOIN series s USING (series_id)
WHERE s.point_id IN ($point) AND r.quality <> 'BAD' AND $__timeFilter(r.sensor_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Measurements (hourly mean)
panels.description: From the summary_1h continuous aggregate: better for weeks or months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.bucket AS time, s.point_id AS metric, m.mean AS value
FROM summary_1h m JOIN series s USING (series_id)
WHERE s.point_id IN ($point) AND $__timeFilter(m.bucket)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy used per hour
panels.description: From the total_1h view: how much each meter total went up per hour (meter resets allowed for).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.bucket AS time, s.point_id AS metric, t.increase AS value
FROM total_1h t JOIN series s USING (series_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.bucket)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: unit1.mode_status: the unit's reported mode over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.sensor_time AS time, r.value_text AS mode
FROM readings r JOIN series s USING (series_id)
WHERE s.point_id = 'unit1.mode_status' AND r.quality <> 'BAD' AND $__timeFilter(r.sensor_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Readings by quality
panels.description: GOOD / SUSPECT / BAD counts in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quality, count(*) AS readings
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(sensor_time)
GROUP BY quality
ORDER BY quality

panels.title: Latest quarantine
panels.description: Messages that couldn't be turned into readings, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ingest_time AS time, stage, source, device, field, reason
FROM quarantine
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingest_time)
ORDER BY ingest_time DESC
LIMIT 50
